defects: Conclusion is wrong: produced states ∃ M, ∀ τ, |f τ| ≤ M (f bounded on the entire upper half-plane), whereas gold states IsBoundedAtImInfty f, i.e. f is bounded only asymptotically as Im τ → ∞ (near the cusp), via the atImInfty filter.
